# FreeRTOS-Kernel source subset

This directory contains the files used by this demo from FreeRTOS-Kernel
`V11.3.1`, commit `3a22924e0a9ddbbc8b0758881c33b3422a5cc20d`.

Included are the kernel sources and public headers, the GCC ARM_CM3 and
ARM_CM33_NTZ/non-secure ports, and `heap_4.c`. The original license is
retained in `LICENSE.md`.
